The entire previous README.md body was moved byte-for-byte into the new docs/project-status.md under an added `# ArrTags project status` H1, and README.md was rewritten as the end-user installation and usage guide. The new README covers: the plugin description (reads metadata from independently configured Sonarr/Radarr and publishes configurable badges such as quality onto Jellyfin Movie/Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs, preserving the original poster); requirements (Jellyfin 12.0.0 only with targetAbi 12.0.0.0 and net10.0; Sonarr 3.x-4.x and/or Radarr 3.x-6.x on /api/v3; host-supplied SkiaSharp per docs/limitations.md F5 with no RID-specific claim and the pinned linux-musl-x64 host note); repository install (Dashboard -> Plugins -> Repositories -> the raw manifest.json URL -> Catalog -> ArrTags -> Install -> restart); manual install fallback (ArrTags_1.0.1.0.zip from the v1.0.1 GitHub Releases page, extracted to <plugins>/ArrTags_1.0.1.0/, restart); configuration (no web UI in v1; edit plugins/configurations/ArrTags.xml under the data directory and restart, with the F2 restart requirement; the real field set from the code - Sonarr/Radarr Enabled/BaseUrl/ApiKey/RequestTimeoutSeconds/AllowInsecureTls, WebhookSecret, BadgeMoviePosters, BadgeEpisodePosters, EnabledLibraries, Renderer.Selectors Selector/Enabled/Template with at most one {value} placeholder, the optional Renderer palette overrides, and Limits; a minimal PluginConfiguration XML example; and the POST /ArrTags/Webhook/Sonarr and POST /ArrTags/Webhook/Radarr endpoints authenticated with the X-ArrTags-Webhook-Secret header); updating (catalog update plus restart, or replace the versioned folder for a manual install); uninstall (Dashboard -> Plugins; completed uninstall restores the original poster and removes the ProgramDataPath/ArrTags state root, with the incomplete-drain retention caveat); and a short honest known-limitations summary linking docs/limitations.md (F1, F2, F5, V1, V3, V4, V5). A footer links docs/project-status.md and docs/release/build-and-release.md. No contributor material (test counts, gates/milestones, build.sh instructions, ADR/GOALS/PLANS/task references) remains in README.md. PLANS.md task 8.1 was marked complete ([x] plus a status note). No other file changed.
